On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find 2x2 blocks
    blocks=[]
    for r in range(H-1):
        for c in range(W-1):
            if g[r][c]==g[r][c+1]==g[r+1][c]==g[r+1][c+1] and g[r][c]!=0:
                blocks.append((r,c))
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    dirs={(-1,-1):8,(-1,1):3,(1,-1):7,(1,1):6}
    for br,bc in blocks:
        for dname,dv in dirs.items():
            # colored cell assigned by offset from block center
            cr,cc=(br+0.5)* (dname[0]>0) + br - int(dname[0]*0.5) if False else None
            # assign cells near block: candidates whose offset matches dv signs
            pass
    # assign each colored cell to a block by nearest center, then direction by quadrant
    import math
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] and not any(br<=i<=br+1 and bc<=j<=bc+1 for br,bc in blocks)]
    for i,j,v in cells:
        best=min(blocks,key=lambda b:(min(abs(i-b[0]),abs(j-b[1]))))
        br,bc=best
        di=i-br-0.5; dj=j-bc-0.5
        drn=int(math.copysign(1,di)); dcn=int(math.copysign(1,dj))
        newc=dirs[(drn,dcn)]
        r,c=i,j
        while True:
            r+=drn; c+=dcn
            if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) or g[r][c]: break
            o[r][c]=newc
    return o

def rays(inp, order=None, stop_at_ray=True, pred=None):
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    claimed=set()  # cells claimed by rays (excluding original singletons & 2s)
    for c in sorted(set(x for r in inp for x in r if x not in (0,2))):
        srcs=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if inp[i][j]==c]
        for (i,j) in srcs:
            for di,dj in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
                k=1
                while True:
                    ni,nj=i+di*k,j+dj*k
                    if not(0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w): break
                    v=inp[ni][nj]
                    if v==2: break
                    if stop_at_ray and (ni,nj) in claimed: break
                    out[ni][nj]=c
                    claimed.add((ni,nj))
                    k+=1
    return out
